result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: 12-month automatic renewals, a 30-day non-renewal right, a Vendor reminder at least 60 days before renewal, and a renewal pricing cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%. It appropriately preserves the existing bilateral post-Initial-Term termination structure and leaves breach and insolvency rights unchanged. Extending the cap to reductions in Customer’s revenue share is a reasonable protection against an economically equivalent price increase. Drafting is professional, though the CPI measure could be defined more precisely and the reminder could be framed as a 60-to-90-day window to ensure it functions as a timely reminder.
